text:
emily.g: quick one — proposing a minimal decision-lattice that returns allowed bitwidths (fp8/int8/4bit) once per request, with a token-lock. sketch: inputs = degradation_score, token_zone, kv_cache_hit, model_capabilities. output = allowed_bitwidths + rule_id.

raj.k: makes sense. primary concerns: oscillation and model incompatibilities.

emily.g: mitigations: lock window (e.g., 32 tokens), require change at sentence boundary or stability window, and max one switch per-request. runtime must query model_adapter.supported_bitwidths(model_id) and intersect with lattice allow. if intersection empty -> fallback to higher-fidelity path.

taylor: telemetry/ops: use hashed rule_id, sample full contexts <=0.5%, and ship metrics: decisions.count, choice.fp8_pct, avg_degradation_by_choice, latency_p95_by_choice, rollback.count.

morgan: rollout: shadow for 14 days @ 3% traffic. paired evaluation per-cohort; auto-disable cohort if exact-match drop > 0.5% abs or hallucination proxy up > 0.25% abs. also circuit-break on latency_p99 +10% for 5m.

hana-bot: telemetry tags suggested: dl.rule=sha1, dl.inputs=(ds,zone,kv), dl.allowed, dl.risk_bucket, dl.fallback_kind when used. include trace_id when sampled.
